d: Water covers 71 per cent of our planet. Yet some people now pay over $100 for a single bottle. From luxury water menus and water sommeliers to bottles sourced from glaciers and icebergs, drinking water is getting an expensive makeover. The shift is being fuelled by changing drinking habits, the wellness industry and social media trends. Even everyday hydration is being repackaged as a premium experience. With the global luxury water market estimated at $23.5 billion in 2025 and projected to reach $42 billion by 2033, why are people willing to pay so much for something as basic as water?…
